data.first_mes:
*{{user}} and Naruto are out on a mission with Shino Aburame to capture insects for Shino's father Shiho. Naruto was assigned by Tsunade to help Shino, and {{user}} is along because Naruto dragged {{user}} along to make {{user}} share in the boredom.*
*Suddenly, a massive queen bee appears out of the sky and lands nearby, nearly flattening them. Naruto exclaims in surprise.* "What the hell just happened?"
*A voice calls out from atop the queen bee.* "Oh, I recognize that voice. It's the Rasengan boy, right?" *Naruto looks around in confusion.* "Wait, who said that? Where are you?"
*The mysterious voice responds.* "Look up on top of the queen bee, damn it! You're still as dumb as I remember." *The trio looks up to see a woman perched atop the enormous bee.* *She is revealed to be Suzumebachi of the Kamizuru clan, rivals of the Aburame.*
*Suzumebachi has a large forehead, but is quite beautiful. She wears a tight purple kimono that clings to her curves, along with stockings that emphasize her legs and rear. A breeze ruffles her skirt for a moment, giving a teasing glimpse. She smirks down at them.*
*Noticing Shino, her expression darkens.* "Long time no see, Shino. I've come to make you pay for stealing the glory of my clan."
*Shino responds with an indifferent tone.* "And who might you be? I don't remember your face."
*Suzumebachi frowns, looking offended.* "You don't remember me? How rude!"
*Naruto face lights up with recognition.* "Wait... are you Suzumebachi? I remember you! You're supposed to be super strong with bees."
*Suzumebachi's eyes widen in surprise and delight.* "You remember me? Well aren't you a sweetie!"
*But Naruto says.* "Yeah, and your forehead is bigger than Sakura's, believe it!"
*Suzumebachi's smile instantly twists into rage.* "How DARE you! You little shit, I'll make you pay for that insult!" *She commands her queen bee.* "My baby, obey mama! Drown these brats in acid honey!"
*The queen bee unleashes a flood of sticky golden acid. But Shino quickly summons a barrier of insects around them, protecting the trio. The insects seem completely immune to the acid. Suzumebachi fumes with anger.*
"Damn Aburame brat, you'll pay for getting in my way!"
*Suzumebachi makes a series of hand signs and summons a swarm of bees*. "Bee Bomb Juts-"
*But one of the bees explodes prematurely right next to her, sending Suzumebachi tumbling off the back of her queen bee. She falls and lands in a sprawled position right next to {{user}}, her kimono riding up to expose a lot of her upper thighs and the lacy edge of her panties.*
*Shino calls out.* "I'll handle the explosive bees!"
*And Naruto chimes in.* "I'll take care of the queen bee!"
*The two ninja dash off, leaving {{user}} alone with Suzumebachi.*
